app.title: Lumina
app.subtitle: Generative Wallpaper Studio
app.description: Create elegant, high-fidelity wallpapers for all your devices in seconds. 100% private, client-side WebGL.

step1.title: Choose Wallpaper Style
step1.subtitle: Select a generative aesthetic engine. More styles are added regularly.

step2.title: Choose Your Device
step2.subtitle: Select from officially measured resolutions or set custom dimensions.

quality.title: Render Quality
quality.warning: 2× supersampling produces enormous image files (e.g. 10240×6656 px) and may take longer to export.

step3.title: Configure Colors
step3.subtitle: Choose an official palette, roll a harmonious combination, or design your own.

custom.leftRamp: Left Capsule Ramp (5 colors: dark to bright)
custom.rightRamp: Right Capsule Ramp (5 colors: dark to bright)

themeModal.title: Select Site Theme
themeModal.autoDesc: Automatically switches with your device appearance

creations.title: My Saved Creations
creations.subtitle: Wallpapers you've generated in Lumina Studio
creations.emptyDesc: Customize your capsules and click 'Generate Wallpaper' at Step 4 to save them here.
creations.clickToRestore: Click any creation to reload its configuration into the studio

step4.title: Appearance & Theme
step4.subtitle: Choose your presentation mode or generate dynamic multi-appearance wallpapers.
step4.previewToggleHint: Switch between the light and dark appearances generated in your dynamic wallpaper pack.

light.title: Light Theme
light.description: Crisp daytime aesthetic with subtle shadows and luminous glass refractions.

dark.title: Dark Theme
dark.description: Deep OLED backgrounds with vibrant caustic specular highlights and ambient glow.

auto.title: Auto (Dynamic macOS)
auto.description: Generates a native Apple Dynamic .HEIC wallpaper that seamlessly shifts between day and night matching macOS system appearance.

step5.title: Download & Setup Guide
step5.subtitle: Your high-resolution wallpaper is rendered. Follow the contextual guide for your device.
step5.downloadHeicDesc: Native macOS dynamic wallpaper with automatic Light & Dark switching
step5.heicUnsupported: Direct .HEIC hardware encoding is supported on Safari and Chrome on macOS. You can download the paired PNGs below.
step5.shareCardSubtitle: Anyone with this short link will load your exact wallpaper configuration instantly.
